description:
Whether the business's cash holds if it takes this one deal, in the caller's own words: the verdict, the
lowest month and amount, what was assumed, and what is still missing with the question to ask the person.
Needs the side, goods, units, prices and the business's cash, minimum cash and fixed costs. Send only what the
person actually stated; never fill a figure in: a missing one comes back to be asked. `open_in_tde` is the form
body that opens the deal on TDE. Nothing is kept.

Figures carry a `provenance` (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY, ESTIMATED or GIVEN; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names figures only the caller holds. Information, not advice.

cash.description: Cash the business holds today, in `currency`.
cash.title: Cash

cost_currency.description: Currency of unit_cost, if it differs from `currency`. Omit if not stated.
cost_currency.title: Cost Currency

currency.description: Currency of the cash, minimum cash and fixed costs (and of the prices unless the next two say otherwise): GBP, USD, EUR, CNY, INR, THB or MYR; a symbol or word such as $ or RMB also reads. Omit if not stated.
currency.title: Currency

customer_days.description: A buyer only: days after a sale until the buyer's own customers pay.
customer_days.title: Customer Days

days_to_pay.description: A seller: days after shipping until the customer pays the balance. A buyer: days after the goods arrive until the supplier's balance is paid.
days_to_pay.title: Days To Pay

deposit_pct.description: Percent paid up front: by a buyer to the supplier, or by a seller's customer.
deposit_pct.title: Deposit Pct

duty_pct.description: A buyer only: duty as a percent of the goods' value, as the person stated it.
duty_pct.title: Duty Pct

fixed_costs.description: Fixed costs each month, in `currency`, as the person stated them.
fixed_costs.title: Fixed Costs

goods.description: What the goods are, in plain words.
goods.title: Goods

lane.description: Where the goods go, from:to, among India, Malaysia, China and the UK: 'india:uk' means from India to the UK. Omit it if the person did not say.
lane.title: Lane

minimum_cash.description: The least cash the business must keep, in `currency`.
minimum_cash.title: Minimum Cash

sell_currency.description: Currency of unit_sell, if it differs from `currency`. Omit if not stated.
sell_currency.title: Sell Currency

sell_per_month.description: A buyer only: units the buyer sells in a month.
sell_per_month.title: Sell Per Month

ship_month.description: The month the goods ship, YYYY-MM. Omit it if not stated: next month is assumed and said.
ship_month.title: Ship Month

side.description: 'buy' if the caller buys the goods, 'sell' if they sell them.
side.title: Side

unit_cost.description: What one unit costs the caller, in `currency`.
unit_cost.title: Unit Cost

unit_sell.description: What one unit sells for, in `currency`.
unit_sell.title: Unit Sell

name: check_deal
title: Check a deal
